text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_component
Description
This iRules command returns the error type according to alert_type.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_component
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert component: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_component]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
